title: Ошибки клиента: фильтр level:warn
query: _time:30m service.name:taskboard level:warn | sort by (_time desc) | limit 30

title: Число событий по сервису и уровню
query: _time:30m service.name:taskboard | stats by (service.name, level) count() as logs_total

title: p95 длительности HTTP и число уникальных путей
query: _time:30m service.name:taskboard _msg:http_request duration_ms:* | stats quantile(0.95, duration_ms) as p95_ms, count_uniq(path) as unique_paths
